resources.string: Sets client_version for Codex model discovery and connection checks, for example 0.160.0. Applies to the next request. This is not the Helix or model version and does not install Codex. Changing it does not verify connectivity or capabilities.
Enter a version such as 0.160.0 or 0.161.0-alpha.8, without spaces, URLs or query parameters.
